dcat_keyword_sm: A city that is green and resilient.
dct_description_sm:
Provides a summary of physical, microbiological, chemical, & radiological test results for each of the City’s five community wells: Carp, Munster Hamlet, Richmond (Kings Park Subdivision, Shadow Ridge, and Vars. For more information on City owned wells and purification plants please visit:

 http://ottawa.ca/en/env_water/water_sewer/water_wells/wells/city_wells/index.html 

Accuracy: There are no known errors included in the data summaries.

Update Frequency: 

Contact: info-water@ottawa.ca

Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.
